independent_failure.root_cause: Lease authority validation is incomplete: an expired but syntactically valid lease is accepted, and lease owner authority is only compared when caller supplies expected_lease_owner. The watchdog therefore cannot independently prove that a durable lease is currently valid and owned by the authoritative worker for the role.
adversarial_cases: state lease expires_at in the past with otherwise valid ISO timestamp is accepted by _authority_error
state lease owner arbitrary but role matches current_role is accepted when expected_lease_owner is omitted
naive ISO expiry without timezone is accepted by datetime.fromisoformat
independent_failure.risk: A stale or foreign lease can survive watchdog authority validation and allow a recovery decision to proceed without independent durable lease authority proof.

repair_acceptance: expired lease must fail closed against authoritative current time
lease owner must map to authoritative worker identity for current role without relying on caller hints
lease expiry must be timezone-aware and parseable
existing packet/hash/role/idempotency protections must remain green
